grammar_title: -ing 与 -ed 分词作补语(宾语补足语:主动进行用 -ing,被动完成用 -ed)
source: 外研社版必修第二册 Unit 6 Using language:-ing and -ed as complement。see/hear/watch/find/keep/have/get 等后接宾语+分词;宾语是动作发出者、动作进行中用 -ing,宾语是动作承受者、动作已完成用 -ed。句子地道、答案唯一(干扰项为错误语态或不定式)。

points.point: -ing 分词作宾补(宾语主动发出、动作进行中)
points.overview: see/hear/watch/notice/find/catch/keep/leave + 宾语 + doing:宾语是动作的发出者、动作正在进行(I saw a shark swimming.)。

points.point: -ed 分词作宾补(宾语承受动作、动作已完成)
points.overview: find/have/get/keep/want/leave + 宾语 + done:宾语是动作的承受者、动作被完成(We found the door locked. / get the work done.)。

points.point: -ing 还是 -ed(由宾语与分词的主动/被动关系判断)
points.overview: 宾语主动发出动作→-ing;宾语承受动作→-ed。干扰项是相反语态或不定式,逐句看宾语和分词谁主动谁被动。

questions.stem: We see a woman ____ at night in a dark, cold sea.
questions.explanation: 宾语 woman 自己在游、动作进行中,主动关系 → -ing 形式 swimming。

questions.stem: Diving near the reef, Lin Feng noticed several fish ____ around the coral.
questions.explanation: fish 自己在游、动作进行,主动 → swimming;swam 是过去式,不能作补语。

questions.stem: All through the night we could hear the waves ____ against the rocks.
questions.explanation: waves 自己拍打、动作进行 → crashing。

questions.stem: On the beach the children found a baby turtle ____ slowly towards the sea.
questions.explanation: turtle 自己在爬动、进行中 → moving。

questions.stem: Suddenly we watched the great white shark ____ straight at the boat.
questions.explanation: shark 自己游过来、动作进行 → coming;came/comes 是谓语形式,不作补语。

questions.stem: From the deck the tourists could see dolphins ____ out of the water.
questions.explanation: dolphins 主动跳跃、进行中 → jumping。

questions.stem: Walking by the river, I could smell something ____ in the dirty water.
questions.explanation: something 自己在腐烂、进行中 → rotting。

questions.stem: The guide kept the engine ____ so the boat would not drift away.
questions.explanation: keep + 宾语 + doing,engine 主动运转、持续中 → running。

questions.stem: Please don't leave the tap ____ while you are brushing your teeth.
questions.explanation: leave + 宾语 + doing,water/tap 主动在流 → running。

questions.stem: The ranger caught a man secretly ____ waste into the clean river.
questions.explanation: catch sb doing,man 主动倾倒、进行中 → dumping。

questions.stem: Early in the morning the staff noticed smoke ____ from the dry forest.
questions.explanation: smoke 自己升起、进行中 → rising。

questions.stem: Visitors often see volunteers ____ rubbish along the nature trail.
questions.explanation: volunteers 主动收集、进行中 → collecting。

questions.stem: All morning we could hear birds ____ in the protected forest.
questions.explanation: birds 主动鸣唱、进行中 → singing。

questions.stem: She felt the cold sea water slowly ____ into her diving boots.
questions.explanation: water 自己渗入、进行中 → leaking。

questions.stem: The opening scene shows a great white shark ____ swimmers near the shore.
questions.explanation: shark 主动攻击、动作进行 → attacking。

questions.stem: Standing on the cliff, we watched the huge waves ____ the old boat away.
questions.explanation: waves 主动卷走、进行中 → carrying。

questions.stem: Even indoors I can hear the strong wind ____ through the trees.
questions.explanation: wind 主动吹、进行中 → blowing。

questions.stem: The scientists observed the polar ice ____ faster than ever before.
questions.explanation: ice 自己融化、进行中 → melting。

questions.stem: We found several children ____ plastic bottles out of the lake.
questions.explanation: children 主动捞取、进行中 → pulling。

questions.stem: Looking down from the glass boat, the diver saw thousands of fish ____ past the reef.
questions.explanation: fish 主动游过、进行中 → passing。

questions.stem: After the storm, we found large areas of forest ____ by the flood.
questions.explanation: forest 被洪水摧毁,被动完成 → -ed 形式 destroyed。

questions.stem: While diving, Benchley saw thousands of sharks ____ just for their fins.
questions.explanation: sharks 被杀,被动 → killed。

questions.stem: The reserve wants the damaged wetland ____ as soon as possible.
questions.explanation: wetland 被修复,被动 → restored。

questions.stem: The staff try to keep the original forest ____ from fire and pollution.
questions.explanation: keep + 宾语 + done,forest 被保护 → protected。

questions.stem: Every summer the heavy rain leaves many low villages ____ under water.
questions.explanation: villages 被淹,被动 → flooded。

questions.stem: The factory had its dirty water ____ before it reached the river.
questions.explanation: have + 宾语 + done,water 被清理 → cleaned。

questions.stem: You can get your empty bottles ____ at the recycling centre.
questions.explanation: get + 宾语 + done,bottles 被回收 → recycled。

questions.stem: We were sad to see so many old trees ____ down to make paper.
questions.explanation: trees 被砍倒,被动完成 → 过去分词 cut。

questions.stem: After the talk, she found her notebook ____ with new green ideas.
questions.explanation: notebook 被写满,被动 → filled。

questions.stem: The government wants the amount of smog ____ in big cities.
questions.explanation: smog 被减少,被动 → reduced。

questions.stem: He had the broken solar panel ____ on the roof last week.
questions.explanation: have + 宾语 + done,panel 被修理 → repaired。

questions.stem: Sadly, we often see local rivers ____ by waste from factories.
questions.explanation: rivers 被污染,被动 → polluted。

questions.stem: Please keep the windows ____ to save the heating in winter.
questions.explanation: keep + 宾语 + done,windows 被关上 → closed。

questions.stem: The Clear Your Plate campaign wants far less food ____ at every meal.
questions.explanation: food 被浪费,被动 → wasted。

questions.stem: After the long drought, farmers found their crops ____ by the dry weather.
questions.explanation: crops 被毁,被动 → ruined。

questions.stem: We should get all these old appliances ____ off at the power supply.
questions.explanation: get + 宾语 + done,appliances 被关闭 → switched。

questions.stem: The diver was shocked to see the sea floor ____ with dead sharks.
questions.explanation: sea floor 被覆盖,被动 → covered。

questions.stem: Last spring the school had hundreds of young trees ____ along the river.
questions.explanation: have + 宾语 + done,trees 被种下 → planted。

questions.stem: Make sure the plug is ____ from the socket before you go to bed.
questions.explanation: plug 被拔下,被动 → removed。

questions.stem: By evening the volunteers had all the rubbish ____ into large bags.
questions.explanation: have + 宾语 + done,rubbish 被装入 → packed。

questions.stem: From the boat I saw the fishermen ____ the fins off the living sharks.
questions.explanation: 宾语 fishermen 主动切割、动作进行 → cutting。

questions.stem: Then I watched the helpless sharks ____ back into the cold sea.
questions.explanation: 宾语 sharks 被扔回,被动 → thrown。

questions.stem: Walking through the woods, we could hear dry leaves ____ under our feet.
questions.explanation: leaves 自己发出脆响、进行中 → crackling。

questions.stem: When the ranger arrived, he found the reserve gate ____ for the night.
questions.explanation: gate 被锁上,被动完成 → locked。

questions.stem: From the high hill we watched the river ____ over the dry fields.
questions.explanation: river 自己漫过、进行中 → flooding。

questions.stem: After the visit, the staff found the wetland badly ____ by human activity.
questions.explanation: wetland 被破坏,被动 → damaged。

questions.stem: We kept the small electric boat ____ so we could leave the bay quickly.
questions.explanation: boat/engine 主动运转、持续中 → running。

questions.stem: The lecturer wants her report on smog ____ before the weekend.
questions.explanation: report 被完成,被动 → finished。

questions.stem: Standing at the window, I noticed thick smog slowly ____ over the city.
questions.explanation: smog 自己蔓延、进行中 → spreading。

questions.stem: During the drought, the villagers had their water supply ____ for days.
questions.explanation: water supply 被切断,被动完成 → cut。

questions.stem: Standing on the shore, we watched the evening tide slowly ____ in.
questions.explanation: tide 自己涨上来、进行中 → coming。

questions.stem: He was sad to see so much plastic ____ behind on the once-clean beach.
questions.explanation: plastic 被遗留,被动 → left。

questions.stem: Near the factory you can smell chemicals ____ in the warm afternoon air.
questions.explanation: chemicals 自己飘浮、进行中 → floating。

questions.stem: The teacher wants all the classroom lights ____ off after the lesson.
questions.explanation: lights 被关掉,被动 → turned。

questions.stem: Through the bus window I saw heavy rain ____ down on the dry land.
questions.explanation: rain 自己倾泻、进行中 → pouring。

questions.stem: After her talk, she found her message box ____ with questions about sharks.
questions.explanation: box 被装满,被动 → filled。

questions.stem: On planting day we watched the volunteers ____ young trees along the bank.
questions.explanation: volunteers 主动栽种、进行中 → planting。

questions.stem: To save money and waste, he got his old bike ____ instead of buying a new one.
questions.explanation: bike 被修理,被动 → repaired。

questions.stem: At dawn we heard wild birds ____ again in the slowly recovering forest.
questions.explanation: birds 主动鸣唱、进行中 → singing。

questions.stem: Scientists want these rare sea animals ____ from extinction before it is too late.
questions.explanation: animals 被拯救,被动 → saved。
